title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): New Resize button (action)
summary: BC28 (2026 release wave 1) adds a Resize action to the column drop-down or right-click menu on list views. It highlights the column edge so the user can drag it or double-click it to auto-fit. The author confirmed the action in BC28.0 and BC28.1 sandboxes, but not in production at the time of writing.
key_points: A new Resize action is in the column header drop-down menu and also appears when you right-click a column name
After you choose Resize, the column edge is highlighted so you can drag it or double-click it to auto-fit
The action works in all list views, not only on List pages
It builds on the drag and double-click column resizing that came in BC15
The author confirmed it in BC28.0 and BC28.1 sandboxes, not in production; hovering over a column edge already shows a blue line

quotes.text: Microsoft has added a new Resize button to the drop-down arrow menu (context menu)
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core feature improvement for easier column resizing without personalizing

quotes.text: this button is not limited to List pages, Microsoft has added this option to all list views across the BC
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the broad applicability of the feature across the entire system

quotes.text: A vertical blue line will automatically highlight whenever you hover your mouse over the edge of a column
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the visual enhancement that makes the feature more discoverable and intuitive
